title: Velvety Tangy Chinese Pasta
description: A fusion of Chinese flavors with Italian pasta, featuring a velvety and tangy ferment-kimchi sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a comal over medium-high heat.
Add 1-inch piece of ginger and 2 cloves of garlic, and cook for 30 seconds.
Add 12 oz of penne pasta and cook for 8-10 minutes or until al dente.
In a blender or food processor, combine 1 cup of ferment-kimchi, 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, 2 tablespoons of rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon of honey, and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil. Blend until smooth.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Pour the kimchi sauce into the skillet and stir to combine with 1/4 cup of chopped green onions and 1 teaspoon of sesame seeds.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with the kimchi sauce.
Season with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and garnish with 1/4 cup of chopped scallions.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the scallions are slightly wilted.
